name: PinePods
description: PinePods is a self-hosted, multi-user podcast server and player. It searches, subscribes to and downloads podcasts and YouTube channels, syncs listening progress across its web, desktop and mobile clients, and works with gPodder-compatible apps.

notes.text: There is no default account. The first visit to the web UI asks you to create the admin user.
HOSTNAME and SERVER_URL in /opt/pinepods_data/.env must match the address you open PinePods at. Change them for a new IP or a reverse proxy, then run systemctl restart pinepods-api.
